sourceLiteralEvidenceNote: Source literal evidence records exact command-id text in source files only; it is not behavior proof and never creates inventory rows.
behaviorEvidenceNote: Behavior evidence links a bounded command row to focused WPF and Avalonia tests; it strengthens parity confidence but does not create inventory rows or change gap classification.
classificationNote: Gap classifications are generated from explicit rule order: shared-profile, profile-shape-only, command-id-alias, platform-only, deferred, then actionable-gap.

classificationRules.name: shared-profile
classificationRules.description: Command is present in both compiled FreeW ribbon profiles.

classificationRules.name: profile-shape-only
classificationRules.description: One-sided row is generated by menu, dropdown, combo, gallery, or palette shape rather than a missing direct behavior.

classificationRules.name: command-id-alias
classificationRules.description: Equivalent or near-equivalent command is exposed by the other profile under a different generated command id.

classificationRules.name: platform-only
classificationRules.description: Command belongs to a host, shell, or desktop-only surface and should not be counted as cross-platform behavior debt.

classificationRules.name: deferred
classificationRules.description: Command belongs to a known richer Word slice that is intentionally not part of the current Avalonia profile surface.

classificationRules.name: actionable-gap
classificationRules.description: Shared Word behavior appears in one compiled profile only and needs product follow-up.
